title: U.S.–China AI governance and supply-chain context

records.event: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng scheduled talks in New York covering AI, trade, tariffs and critical minerals ahead of the Trump–Xi summit.
President Donald Trump and President Xi Jinping are scheduled to meet in Washington; Reuters reports AI governance, advanced chip access, trade, Taiwan and other issues are among expected topics.

U.S. and Chinese security experts proposed safeguards including human oversight for critical cyber operations and crisis-communication channels; the proposals had not been formally adopted by either government at publication.

editorial_rule: Describe this as diplomacy, competition, interdependence and possible guardrail-building. Do not call it U.S.–China AI collaboration unless a specific cooperative agreement is documented.
